description: Get estimated sponsor fee revenue of US spot crypto ETFs: net assets times the prospectus sponsor fee, with temporary fee waivers applied. Per fund: net assets, nominal and effective fee (percent per year), revenue per day and annualised at current assets, and the sum for the last 30 days where a daily series exists. Totals by issuer and for the whole market. Arithmetic on the published fee, not the issuer's reported revenue; the sponsor's share of staking rewards is not included.

asset.description: Optional asset filter for the fund list: btc, eth, sol, xrp, hyp, doge, link, avax, hbar, ltc, bnb, dot, sui, near, trx, zec

name: get_issuer_revenue
title: Crypto ETF Issuer Fee Revenue
